date: c. 15 CE (copy of bronze original c. 20 BCE)
notes: Idealized official image; breastplate depicts return of Parthian standards (20 BCE); Cupid at foot references Julian descent from Venus. Discovered 1863 at Villa of Livia, Prima Porta.

title_en: Via Labicana Augustus (Augustus as Pontifex Maximus)
notes: Depicts Augustus veiled (capite velato) as Pontifex Maximus; complementary to the Prima Porta military image
Coins proclaim CAESAR AVGVSTVS, DIVI F, PATER PATRIAE; created standard for imperial coinage
